section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section presents a study comparing body image between Zimbabwean women in Zimbabwe and Britain. The study operationalizes body image through actual-ideal weight discrepancy and body appreciation (assessed via the Body Appreciation Scale), hypothesizing that Zimbabwean women in Britain would show more negative body image due to greater exposure to Western media and cultural distance. The research addresses a gap in the literature regarding body image among non-Western migrants in both origin and host cultures.
